evidence.title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty

summary: A new class of large language models, called credal LLMs, integrates probabilistic reasoning to handle semantic commitments amid uncertain or ambiguous inputs. This research aims to improve the reliability of AI inference and decision‑making when information is incomplete or noisy.
title: Researchers Introduce Credal Large Language Models to Manage Semantic Commitment Under Uncertainty
